en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Muhammad b. Abi’l Qasim narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Abi `Umar al-`Adani in Meca from Abi’l `Abbas b. Hamza from Ahmad b. Sawar from `Ubaydallah b. `Asim from Salama b. Wardan from Anas b. Malik. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

If a believer dies, leaving behind one sheet of knowledge, that sheet will be a curtain between him and the Fire on the Day of Resurrection. For every letter written on it, Allah will grant him a city that is seven times wider than this world. A believer does not sit to learn for one moment except that his Lord calls to him, saying: “You have sat to attend to My beloved. By My glory and My majesty! I will have you live in Paradise with it, regardless [of your sins].”
